errors.evidence: Description states the red line starts at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, but it actually starts slightly below -1%.
Description states the red line drops to approximately -3% at Layer5-12, but it drops to just below -3%.
Description states the dark blue line drops to approximately -5.5% at Layer5-12, but the line actually dips to about -4.5%.
Description states the dark blue line reaches its minimum at approximately -15% at Layer13-20, but it actually reaches approximately -12%.
Does not specify the correct axis labels as 'Relative Change' and 'Layer Groups'.
The phrase 'using a 4× tokens, 4-bit baseline' could be clearer if rephrased for conciseness.
